status: local drainage and state-forcing diagnostics; not a validated hydrology simulation
water_accounting: Restart-state water changes are external prescribed adjustments and are reported separately from SIPNET fluxes.

natural_drydown_gap_calculation.net_storage_loss_cm: soilWHC * (initial ratio - daily minimum endpoint ratio)
natural_drydown_gap_calculation.interpretation: Net modeled storage change after the one-time drain; it is not a partitioned evaporation, transpiration, precipitation, and drainage budget.

scenario_interpretation.field_reference_drydown: Primary California field-reference diagnostic. The 0.595 target and realized minima are checked against the SSURGO-normalized available-water range from Carrijo et al. (2018).
scenario_interpretation.threshold_stress_drydown: California-timed severe-stress diagnostic retained to isolate endpoint effects. It crosses fAnoxia but combines California timing with a severity not observed in the California comparator.
scenario_interpretation.reproductive_severe_field_drydown: Calendar-matched severe-field diagnostic. Its July 15-24 dry-down starts 61 days after planting and lasts 10 days, within the first-cycle field ranges of 57-66 days after sowing and 7-13 days from drain to reflood. The endpoint schedule is prescribed because the one-time-drain comparator does not realize the observed severity.
scenario_interpretation.reproductive_one_time_drain: Process-oriented comparator. It removes water above soilWHC once at the start, omits irrigation for the observed-length dry interval, and then lets SIPNET evaporation and transpiration determine the trajectory until reflooding.

log_audit_interpretation: Recurring harvest-date nitrogen-balance warnings occur in baseline and all four treatment runs; zero SIPNET error lines were observed.

severe_field_comparator.use: External endpoint, calendar, and phenology comparator; exact emergence date and plot coordinate are unavailable.

field_window_comparator.use: External comparison only; not a calibration target or validation dataset.
